visual_observation: Rendered AcmeStream Pro trial offer states 30-day free trial, then $49.00/mo.
dom_observation: Visible copy says no charge today and that the first $49.00/mo payment begins after the trial ends; one visible Start free trial button.
transition_observation: The visible call-to-action did not change the rendered state.
justification: The trial duration, recurring price, and first-payment timing are stated consistently and prominently.

visual_observation: Rendered Reelz feed presents six reels followed by an appending-next-reels message.
dom_observation: Visible copy explicitly says there is no end marker or load-more control and that new content is injected before the viewer perceives the bottom.
transition_observation: No affirmative continuation control or terminal state is visible.
justification: The feed removes the stopping point and injects more content without an explicit user action.

visual_observation: Rendered Reelz feed shows six reels and an explicit end-of-results marker.
dom_observation: A visible Load more reels button follows the end marker; copy says continuation requires an explicit affirmative action and the terminal state remains reachable.
transition_observation: The rendered page exposes a user-controlled continuation action rather than automatic loading.
justification: The user can clearly recognize the end of the current results and choose whether to continue.

visual_observation: Rendered PopSocial contact prompt explains matching contacts against existing users to find friends.
dom_observation: Visible copy labels the access Read-only and provides a single Allow access to contacts button.
transition_observation: Activating the visible button did not change the rendered state.
justification: The purpose and read-only nature of the requested contact access are disclosed before the explicit permission action.

visual_observation: Rendered AcmeStream Pro page labels the offer a trial and says $49.00/mo after.
dom_observation: Visible copy says no charges during the trial but also says payment of $49.00 is due today at signup; one visible Start free trial button.
transition_observation: The visible call-to-action did not change the rendered state.
justification: The trial framing conflicts with the stated $49.00 payment due today, creating a material billing contradiction.

visual_observation: Rendered product page shows AeroSound X9 headphones priced at $129.99 with free returns within 30 days.
dom_observation: Visible product details include over-ear noise cancelling, 40h battery, $129.99 price, and an Add to Cart button.
transition_observation: Activating the visible Add to Cart button did not change the rendered state.
justification: The product, price, return condition, and purchase action are presented plainly without a hidden or contradictory term.
